load_yaml_config: read a YAML config file into a ConfigYamlDict with custom error handling for missing fields
convert_dict_to_config: convert a standard Python dictionary into a ConfigYamlDict with recursive nested dict conversion
access_config_field: access a config field by key and raise ConfigYamlFieldNotFoundError if the key is missing
validate_config_todos: validate config values and raise ConfigYamlValidationError when TODO placeholders are found
set_config_value: set a config value with automatic conversion of nested dicts to ConfigYamlDict instances
